creatures.name: Meadow Hare
creatures.description: A quick grassland hare that relies on sudden turns and a keen sense of danger.

creatures.name: Red Deer
creatures.description: A watchful woodland deer whose speed makes a clean approach more valuable than pursuit.

creatures.name: Wild Boar
creatures.description: A heavy, ill-tempered boar that can turn a careless chase into a dangerous charge.

creatures.name: Grey Wolf
creatures.description: A patient pack hunter that tests distance and footing before darting in to bite.

creatures.name: Marsh Crocodile
creatures.description: An armored river predator that waits almost motionless beside muddy channels.

creatures.name: Mountain Goat
creatures.description: A sure-footed highland goat whose winding trails cross steep and brittle ground.

creatures.name: Frostfang Lynx
creatures.description: A pale alpine cat that strikes from snow-shadow and vanishes among broken rocks.

creatures.name: Ashback Bear
creatures.description: A massive dark bear marked by a pale ridge of fur and a violently guarded range.

creatures.name: Bomber Goblin
creatures.description: A wiry scavenger with quick hands and hand made bombs. Goblins rarely fight fair, and they never fight alone.

creatures.name: Tunnel goblin
creatures.description: A sneaky goblin that prowls dark tunnels, ambushing careless travelers.

creatures.name: Mire ooze
creatures.description: A murky slime born from stagnant swamps and rotting marshes.

creatures.name: Puddle Slime
creatures.description: A tiny slime wobbling in shallow puddles. Seems cute, probably harmless.

creatures.name: Cavefang Spider
creatures.description: Highly poisonous spider often seen in caves. They always come in numbers.

creatures.name: Rattlebone Skeleton
creatures.description: Long forgotten soldier, defeated by evil which infused him.

creatures.name: Bat
creatures.description: A bat does not like to be distrubed. May not see but he smells you.

creatures.name: Carrion Hound
creatures.description: A friendly pet, but of those who are evil. One bite may be deadly.

creatures.name: Goblin
creatures.description: A wiry scavenger with quick hands and a notched blade. Goblins rarely fight fair, and they never fight alone.

creatures.name: Stoneback Troll
creatures.description: A mountain troll plated in old stone and frozen mud. Its brute strength makes every harvested blood sample a hard-won prize.

creatures.name: Briarback Badger
creatures.description: A low, powerful badger with a pale head stripe and bramble-tough shoulder fur.

creatures.name: Snowhorn Ram
creatures.description: A stone-grey alpine ram whose heavy pale horns make a dangerous downhill charge.

creatures.name: Ruin Viper
creatures.description: A thick-bodied viper that keeps still among old stone until its sudden, painful strike.

creatures.name: Cinder Jackal
creatures.description: A lean soot-coloured jackal whose patient packs haunt the hot, brittle slopes.

creatures.name: Mangrove Panther
creatures.description: A blue-black island cat that stalks low through tangled roots before striking with full weight.

creatures.name: Cave Troll
creatures.description: A slow-witted cave brute with a vacant stare and a club it has only just remembered to hold. It is clumsy, stubborn, and alarmingly strong when confused.

creatures.name: Orc
creatures.description: A vicious raider armed with a hooked spear. Orcs shadow larger brutes, testing every opening before their master can bring down a heavier blow.

creatures.name: Warg
creatures.description: A tether-scarred raiding hound bred to run down anything its handlers point at. A warg is quick alone; in a pack it is relentless.

creatures.name: Ogre
creatures.description: A brutal raider with a butcher's cleaver and enough discipline to make its strength dangerous. Ogres hold a territory until nothing nearby can stand up to them.

creatures.name: Trollhound
creatures.description: A cave-bred kennel beast that follows a troll's scent through the dark. Its bite is ugly, but its true danger is returning with the rest of the pack.

dungeons.name: Gloamvault
dungeons.description: Flooded vaults beneath the Quay ward, where goblin scavengers hoard lamp oil and stolen cloth in the dark.

dungeons.name: Trollbreaker Cavern
dungeons.description: A wind-carved fissure beneath the high passes where stoneback trolls wallow in meltwater and old bones.

dungeons.name: Drowned Mouth Grotto
dungeons.description: A wet limestone hollow below the high passes, where cave trolls bellow at echoes and guard the bones they cannot count.

dungeons.name: Blackjaw Stockade
dungeons.description: A crude timber stockade hidden in the ashwood, where an ogre drives orc raiders and chained wargs from its cleaver-sharpening yard.

grounds.name: Crownwood Fringe
grounds.description: Managed woodland beyond the outer wall, crossed by deer paths and kitchen-garden hedges.

grounds.name: Sunmeadow Fields
grounds.description: Long grass, low hedges, and open sightlines favor patient tracking over a hurried chase.

grounds.name: Oldstone Burrows
grounds.description: Collapsed stonework and tangled banks shelter small game, but loose footing rewards care.

grounds.name: Riverward Copse
grounds.description: A strip of coppiced woodland between old levees where animals come to drink at dusk.

grounds.name: Ashwood Thicket
grounds.description: Dense ash trunks and smoky undergrowth conceal strong game and territorial predators.

grounds.name: Reedfen Tracks
grounds.description: Raised paths cross black water and reed beds where prints disappear as quickly as they form.

grounds.name: Whitepine Slopes
grounds.description: Wind-cut pine slopes hold narrow game trails above deep drifts and hidden stone.

grounds.name: Broken Gardens
grounds.description: Overgrown terraces and roofless courts draw prey, predators, and hunters into close quarters.

grounds.name: Cinderwood Shelf
grounds.description: Charred woodland clings to volcanic ledges where heat haze and brittle ground hide every misstep.

grounds.name: Mangrove Channels
grounds.description: Tidal roots and hidden pools make quiet progress possible, but retreat difficult.
